label: Font file
help: A TrueType (.ttf), OpenType (.otf) or WOFF font. It's read in your browser and never leaves your device.

label: Convert to
help: The container to convert into. The glyph outlines are unchanged; only the wrapper differs. WOFF2 is recognised but not converted yet.

label: Glyphs

options.label: Basic Latin (A to Z, digits, punctuation)

help: A subset keeps only the glyphs those characters need, which makes a much smaller file. TrueType outlines only. A font whose own embedding flags forbid subsetting is never subset.

label: Characters to keep
help: Type or paste every character the font must still draw. Order and repeats do not matter.
